verdict.rationale: Claude Code is referenced as an official CLI ('Build with Claude Code in your terminal') in docs-8/23, and multiple community threads (comm-1, comm-12, comm-13, comm-15) confirm it is actively used by developers for agentic coding, though one hands-on report notes an 'empty unresponsive terminal' and code-quality complaints about the CLI's implementation. The evidence pack lacks a dedicated CLI documentation article (install, commands, config) — the CLI is only mentioned incidentally alongside the Chrome extension workflow. Missing for 10: dedicated official CLI docs/reference, install/usage guide, and stronger independent corroboration of reliability beyond scattered community anecdotes.
